title: Why AI Voices Still Can't Laugh or Whisper Right
topic: Text-to-speech handles words well but non-verbal sounds like laughs, breaths and sighs are harder: research cites scarce, clean training data.
hook: AI can read a book aloud. But ask it to laugh.
twist: Nearly all training data is clean speech; laughs and breaths are rare and messy, so models fake them.
pinnedComment: Can you spot an AI voice by its laugh, or is it already perfect? 👇
commentPrompt: Real laugh or AI laugh: which would you trust more?
loop: So... would you notice a fake laugh?
weaknesses: Whispering: no paper found measuring TTS whisper failures; either drop it or find a source on script day. 'Still can't' is strong: say 'often sound off' and name no vendor.
